meta.columns_note: Every column and cell exactly as the SBA released it, as strings, in the SBA file order. An empty string is an empty cell. A byte the SBA file holds that is not valid UTF-8 (0xBF, in a few lender and business-type names) is shown as ¿. Nothing is filtered: sole proprietors, self-employed individuals and independent contractors are included, and so are the PPP Race, Ethnicity, Gender and Veteran fields.
